latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Generator by Link — Create Videos from URLs.

- Instantly generate 1080p MP4 videos from URLs (webpages, YouTube, articles) or direct uploads (MP4, MOV, WebM, AVI, up to 500MB).
- Simple workflow: provide a link or file, describe your needs, and get a generated video ready to post—no manual editing required.
- Includes credit system with anonymous token support and free trial credits (100, valid for 7 days).
- Full support for uploading, exporting, checking credits and status, and summarizing video timelines via API-driven cloud pipeline.
- Designed for marketers, bloggers, and creators seeking fast, no-fuss video generation from online content.
